name: Huangcheng Yishi
source: In this Chinese classical literature and adventure game, the protagonist and the 9 heroines with different identities and nationalities in the game will meet on different occasions and times, and then weave a series of fascinating romantic sparks.
translation: 在這款以中國古典文學為背景的冒險遊戲中，主角將在不同的時間與場合，邂逅9位身分與國籍各異的女主角，交織出一連串引人入勝的浪漫火花。
